id.description: Stable uppercase identifier (primary key), e.g. EU, NATO, UN. Renames are tracked in data/datasets/intblocks_aliases.json.

name.description: Official English name of the organization, group, or agreement.

blocktype.description: Taxonomy keys from the blocktypes dataset (list). The record's directory under data/intblocks/ matches the primary blocktype.

status.description: Formality of the entity: e.g. 'formal' (treaty-based organization) or informal grouping.

links.description: Related URLs as {url, type} where type is website, wikipedia, or wikidata.

includes.description: Membership roster. Join on includes[].id (country code or intblock id per type); includes[].name is a display label only (for type: country the build sets it to the country's name). status captures member/observer/former_member etc. (see data/schemas/includes_status.yaml); joined/left are ISO dates.

name.description: Display label. For type: country the build sets it to the country's name, and the source value is optional; other types keep their source label.

role.description: Function of the country on an infrastructure route (gaspipeline, oilpipeline or corridor records only); values defined in data/schemas/include_roles.yaml.

founded.description: Foundation date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD) or decade (e.g. 1950s) when only decade precision is known

dissolved.description: Dissolution date (ISO string) for defunct entities.

active_period.description: Operational period as {start, end} ISO date strings; end is absent for active entities.

headquarters.description: Seat of the organization as {city, country, coordinates{lat,lng}} with an alpha-2 country code.

scope_category.description: Entity-kind taxonomy: igo, treaty_body, policy_forum, reference_enumeration, intergovernmental_body, or non_state_organization. This classifies the record itself, not the role of entries in includes. See docs/intblock-inclusion-policy.md.

regions.description: Region labels covered by the entity (e.g. 'worldwide', 'europe', 'africa').

partof.description: Parent organization id(s) for suborganizations (string or list in source; normalized to a list in exports).

suborganizations.description: Child entities as {id, name} references to other intblock records.

wikidata_id.description: Wikidata entity id (Q-number) for cross-referencing and entity linking.

membership_count.description: Officially stated member count. Interpreted as country members unless membership_count_type says otherwise; compared against the includes roster by validation.

membership_count_type.description: Unit of membership_count. When absent, the count is interpreted as country members and is compared against the includes roster. Non-country counts (companies, individual experts, national governing bodies, etc.) are exempt from roster comparison but require provenance for membership_count.

membership_applicability.description: When not_applicable, an empty country/organization includes roster is intentional. The entity may still have institutional or individual members that this dataset does not model (e.g. NGOs), or have no separate member states (e.g. a subsidiary office or fund).

last_verified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the record was last checked against official sources.

description.description: Short text summarizing what the entity is for

tags.description: List of keywords for the entity

topics.description: List of topics with which this entity is associated

other_names.description: Names in multiple languages (UN official languages)

notes.description: Additional notes or historical information about the entity

legal_status.description: Legal character of the entity (e.g. intergovernmental, treaty, non-binding)

recognition_status.description: How the entity is recognized within a broader system (e.g. UN specialized agency)

predecessor.description: Id of the entity this one succeeded

successor.description: Id of the entity that succeeded this one

previous_names.description: Former names with the period they were used

official_documents.description: Links to founding or official documents

social_media.description: Social media handles keyed by platform

institutional_design.description: What the founding instrument lets the organization decide and enforce. Optional; an absent object or subfield means unknown, not none. Values are defined in data/schemas/institutional_design.yaml. Allowed only on igo, treaty_body, policy_forum and intergovernmental_body records, with provenance.

mandate.description: Primary policy domain from the purposes article of the founding instrument.

decision_rule.description: Default voting rule of the principal decision-making organ for its main acts.

decision_force.description: Whether the principal organ's main acts bind members.

independent_organs.description: Standing organs whose members do not act as state representatives; [none] when the instrument establishes none.

enforcement.description: Measures the organization can decide against a member; [none] when the instrument provides none.

mutual_defence.description: true only when an instrument binding all members obliges assistance against an armed attack on a member.

veto_holders.description: Country alpha-2 codes of members with a treaty-granted veto that other members lack.
